question: Can fixed class opportunities and any nonnegative two-resource prices accommodate early nitrogen-share redistribution when measured preliminary quota changes and every pooled-species mixture are allowed?
prior_exposure: All source outcomes and the failed 2026-10-02 forecasts were previously inspected. This freezes a new diagnostic, not unseen outcomes or confirmation.
baseline_estimator: Separate species medians of N/volume and C/volume at days -4 and 0
postpulse_estimator: Exact species N/volume and C/volume at matching preliminary day; no interpolation or extrapolation
pooling: Allow every Mo/Co biovolume mixture independently at baseline and target; no fitted mixture
missingness: Retain missing, invalid or zero-total baseline/target rows as unscored; no fallback or imputation
decision: Conditional bound exceedance if a feasible dual lower certificate for minimum observed TV over both pooled-mixture segments exceeds TV_upper by more than numerical_tolerance; otherwise bound not exceeded, not support
sampling_scope: Descriptive same-vessel point comparisons; no p-values, independence claims, confidence intervals, fitted prices or new neutrality verdict
interpretation_limit: Exceedance excludes the conjunction of fixed aggregate opportunities, two-resource proportional allocation and transferred preliminary densities for the recorded observations. Preliminary cultures do not measure main-vessel physiology. Unknown assay errors are not covered.
